caption: The drawing depicts a single garment consisting of a skirt and a matching cape or jacket. The skirt is long, ankle-length, and dark gray in color, with a slightly flared silhouette. The cape or jacket worn over the skirt is shorter, ending above the hips, and features a high, round collar. It has a floral or vine-like black lace pattern overlay on a lighter gray base. The collar, edge of the cape, and sleeve ends are trimmed with a thick, ruffled black ribbon. The overall composition shows the garment centered on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or details present.
